http.allowlistSummary: Which databases can the tunnel reach? (allowlist)
http.allowlistIntro4: on the server. An explicit list replaces the default: include
http.allowlistWildcardNote2: the tunnel can reach any host visible to the PHP server, including its internal network: anyone with the token can use it as a bridge. Protect it with a strong token and HTTPS. Even so, 169.254.0.0/16 (cloud metadata), 0.0.0.0/8, fe80::/10, and multicast are always blocked, and hostnames are validated by their resolved IP.
http.timeoutUnit: s (max 120; the PHP server may cut off earlier)
